voice.summary: VIKTORODDY sounds like a designer who has stopped being modest. It is short, large and bold, with massive words in capitals and almost nothing after them.
dos: Use one big word instead of a sentence
Write in capitals for headlines only
Let the projects carry the proof
donts: Do not write a biography paragraph
Do not apologise for the size

boilerplate: VIKTORODDY is the portfolio of a designer working in bold, energetic visuals, showing selected projects and a blog.
